svg.title: ELLIOT voice pipeline
svg.desc: Android capture feeds GTCRN. Wake detection normally uses filtered input. Eligible calibrated profiles can bypass software GTCRN for wake while request audio remains filtered. Wake or tapping starts request capture, then on-device STT, routing and reply.

g.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Wake detection and command recognition have separate jobs and filter settings.
Wake can listen before software denoising.
Request audio still uses enhanced filtering.
Solid paths are standard. Dashed path is optional.
Offline tool or chosen conversation provider
Native inference runs in the private :speech process.
